subject.title: feat(ui): per-user chat bubble colors for logged-in senders

question: Should attributed sender identity colors become the default visual treatment for Control UI chat bubbles, with no per-user preference or opt-out?
rationale: The patch is a new user-visible default rather than a repair to an established behavior contract, and the protected maintainer label requires explicit human handling.

options.title: Adopt the default tint
options.body: Approve the deterministic identity-derived tint as the default, then rebase and merge after a refreshed UI review.

options.title: Keep current neutral bubbles
options.body: Decline the default visual change and close the implementation while preserving the feature discussion for a future sponsored design.

options.title: Require a different UX design
options.body: Ask for a narrower visual treatment or an explicit preference model before accepting the feature.

recommendation.title: Adopt the default tint
recommendation.body: Approve the deterministic identity-derived tint as the default, then rebase and merge after a refreshed UI review.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked feature proposal and the implementation, making them the clearest available routing contact for the design decision.
